messages:
Sam: heads-up — p99 for canary (model=redwood-medium, region=eu-west) jumped from ~120ms -> ~420ms after today's runtime deploy r-2026.03.17. Dashboard: https://dash/reports/abcd :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya: deploy shows as finished at 03:10 UTC. looking.
DeployBot: deploy r-2026.03.17 -> eng-runtime/canary finished at 2026-03-17T03:10:12Z by @Maya
Sam: throughput looks fine, but tail is terrible. appears CPU-bound on inference nodes, lots more attention compute on p99.
Liam: quick profiler dump (first pass) — KV cache hit rate dropped a ton on canary: 0.92 -> 0.68. Also noticed KVCACHE_PREFETCH=false in this build.
Liam: ```
summary:
  p50: 45ms
  p95: 210ms
  p99: 420ms
  kv_hit_rate: 0.68
  kernel_selected: matmul-v2 (was fft-optimized)
  microbatch_max_tokens: 64 (was 32)
```
Maya: i flipped kernel_autoselect=true and bumped microbatch_max_tokens 32->64 to increase throughput. I didn't expect KV prefetch to be toggled off — investigating why the flag changed in the canary bundle.
Sam:KV hit drop explains tail: uncached requests pay full attention cost. Recommendation: revert canary to previous runtime (re-enable kv prefetch + pin kernel) while we root-cause autoselect heuristics.
Ruth (oncall): agree. initiating rollback to r-2026.03.16 for canary now. @DeployBot please trigger rollback. :rotating_light:
DeployBot: rollback initiated: canary -> r-2026.03.16 by @Ruth (oncall) at 2026-03-17T03:22:03Z
DiagBot: canary nodes draining, new version incoming. healthchecks passing as nodes come up.
Ruth (oncall): rollback completed; monitoring shows p99 returned to ~115ms within ~90s. :white_check_mark:
Sam: nice. let's add a canary gate: fail deploy if kvcache_hit_rate drops >5% or if p95/p99 worsens significantly within first 5m. Also avoid kernel_autoselect flips during short-sequence-heavy workloads until we validate.
Maya: will push a follow-up CL: set kernel_autoselect=false in canary, re-enable kv_prefetch, and add a perf-job that simulates many short sequences to guard against this.
Liam: i'll collect the detailed traces and make an eval deck (kernel choices vs cached/uncached paths). early signal: autoselect prefers matmul-v2 for latency-optimized path, but it regresses badly when KV cache pressure changes.
Sam: thanks. filing an incident ticket and assigning to eng-runtime/perf for postmortem and follow-ups.
Maya: noted — i'll coordinate with QA for the perf-job and map the config matrix.
Sam: closing this thread — good rollback/response. :thumbsup:
